sections.value: e.g., RE: MR IKECHUKWU PROMISE V. ZAP NIG. LIMITED SUIT NO _______

value:
e.g., i am glad to inform you that judgment in the above suit was delivered on the 6th April, 2025, in your favour and the sum of N50,000,000 (fifty million naira) was awarded to you as damages against the defendant.

e.g., while we await the defendant's next line of action, we wish to bring to your attention, that we can take steps to enforce the said judgment. 

e.g., Please find attached a certified true copy of the judgment.

Yours faithfully
